now.headline: Stage 0 — Hello Python
now.detail: Install Python and the editor from the links in PINS.md, open a terminal, print one line, then change one thing at a time. Eight rungs, about two hours, no account, no git yet. Tick Run/See/Say in PROGRESS.md after each rung; when all eight are ticked, start stage 1 rung 0.
now.next: Stage 1 — Values and names: rung 0 installs uv, just and git, clones the course and turns 57 tests red; rungs 1–9 turn them green and end with the receipt.
now.later: Stage 2 — Decisions and repetition (ruff, GitHub, the text game). Stage 3 is rung-numbered while you are in stage 2.

stages.name: Hello Python

stages.note: Comparison memo; context managers as author.

stages.note: Break-my-program, teach-back, hand-off to the sibling courses.

maintainer_queue.task: Classify feedback items; apply rung changes to s00; cascade to s01 Assumes; log in REVISIONS.md. Run s00 on Windows on a machine without Python.
Run every s01 code block on the pins (both platforms for r0); confirm the 57-red / `-k r1e` counts match the brief; mark s01 verified.
Run every s02 code block on the pins; verify the GitHub fork, Pages and PR steps end to end on a fresh account; mark s02 verified.
Rung-number s03 with s00–s02 feedback: exercises with embedded fixture literals, hidden cases, solutions, break-lab, rubric anchors; reconcile threshold; `just progress`.
Extend course/runner.py and conftest for function-stub exercises (import and call); provide the debugger rung's buggy program.
Mutation check in scripts/eval.py; confirm the public API still returns the three fields (PINS.md step 6).
Build the 200-line script, the stranger's PR branch in upstream, and the twelve-bug package with its answer key outside the learner path; decide pre-commit rung vs stretch.
Confirm the sibling course's Stage 0 Contract is stable; capstone hidden cases as subprocess runs on the fixture and broken files.
